description: Make sounds in a Game kit: each sound gets up to four takes. While the kit's makes are free (free makes, or an unlocked game) it starts at once. When they cost credits it answers with the price instead: ask the user, then call again with confirm_credits set to that price. A kit that needs unlocking answers with unlock_url: the user pays on that page, never the agent.

confirm_credits.description: The credits the user agreed to spend, as quoted by the previous call.

sound_ids.description: Sounds to make or remake (default: every listed sound not made yet).

use_credits.description: Explicitly use credits instead of an active Kit daily allowance. Requires confirm_credits after the quoted cost is accepted; never enable automatically.

name: make_kit_sounds
